en: Soft Saber Pelts
Bring $1oa Soft Nightsaber Pelts to Aldria.

Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?

Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.

Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.
Deflective Surface
Bring $1oa Redstone Basilisk Scales to Bernie Heisten.

You may have seen the Redstone basilisks wandering the wastes outside while you were on your way to Nethergarde Keep. They're tough creatures, well adapted to survival in the Blasted Lands. One of their key qualities is their sturdy scales, which reflect heat, protect against sand and wind, and even deflect weapon blows!

They're a perfect material for making shields, and if you can bring me a bundle, I'll compensate you well. Only bring ones in good condition!
Hearts of the Lost
Search for Corma's partner Essene.

Thandol Span has been a dangerous place since the Dark Irons blew up the bridge, but I didn't expect to run into them there!

I managed to escape, but I lost sight of my partner, Essene. I've been searching all over for her, but I haven't found any sign of her. Did the Dark Irons capture her? Did she fall into the river below? Did she make it back to the other side? I don't know! I don't even know if she's alive!

Please, if you see any sign of her, let me know!
Chieftain Bloodmaw
Kill Chieftain Bloodmaw and bring his mace to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.

When the Legashi overran the Blackmaw, the rest of the Timbermaw sealed their passage to the hold to keep out the satyr. We had no idea they lived on as refugees.

I would gladly aid my brethren, but we are fighting our own battles. Like the Legashi threaten the Blackmaw, the Deadwood do likewise to us. We haven't many warriors to spare.

The Deadwood chieftain, Bloodmaw, is in Felpaw Village to the south. Eliminating him would greatly ease our struggle. Bring me his mace, and you will have our aid.
Memories of Rockard
Take the Carved Stone Trinket to Dispatch Commander Ruag in Stonard, in the Swamp of Sorrows.

This trinket, carried by the ogre, seems to be a small stone carving depicting an orc family. It may be a memento from the orcs who lived here when this was the town of Rockard, before the ogres invaded.

It probably has sentimental or spiritual value to the survivors at Stonard.
Spark of Freedom
Escort the captive fire elemental out of Dun Modr and to its freedom.

Sss! The foul Dark Irons have summoned me and kept me caged next to their petty fire pit!

Fire must run wild, run free! Release me! Must escape! Must BURN!

No Dark Iron is safe! Burn them to the ground! Burn their black powder! Burn their fortress, their fuses, their folly!

Let me out and I will BURN THEM ALL!

That was quite a pyrotechnic display! I don't think I've seen anything quite like it!$B$BGlad the fire elemental, uh, ran outta steam, as it were. Coulda been bad if it had decided to go after the rest of us instead of those Dark Irons!
Uncanny Crystal
Bring $1oa Damaged Blue Crystal back to Torwa Pathfinder.

You may have seen some of the unusual crystal growths that dot this crater. I'm not a miner, but these growths don't seem to fit with the kinds of soil deposits all around here.

I believe I caught sight of a damaged crystal not far from here while I was foraging. I wonder if it holds any secrets about the origins of these strange formations? If you happen to spot it, I would love to investigate a sample piece.
Microcrystal Contamination
Take the Crystal Infused Scale to Torwa Pathfinder.

This scale is slightly more reflective and iridescent than the others, as if it's embedded with tiny particles of crystal.

Torwa Pathfinder might be able to make something of this.
Holy Diver
Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.

I have received word back from Darnassus, $n!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!

This has been a long journey, $N, but it was worth it.$B$BAt long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace.$B$BThank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.
